scope: Illustrated beginner setup for 3 and 4 players; strict roll-trade-build; variable setup and experienced merged phases excluded

scenarios.title: Three-player exact board and pieces
scenarios.expectation: The exact page-1 19-hex terrain/number/harbor layout is used; robber is on the central desert; all red roads/settlements are absent; blue, orange and white each have the two pictured settlements and roads and remaining stock 13 roads, 3 settlements, 4 cities.

scenarios.title: Three-player lettered starting resources
scenarios.expectation: With red A removed: blue B has wood 1, brick 1, wool 0, grain 0, ore 1; orange C has wood 0, brick 0, wool 0, grain 2, ore 1; white D has wood 1, brick 0, wool 1, grain 0, ore 1.

scenarios.title: Three-player bank, deck and initial action
scenarios.expectation: Open bank counts are wood 17, brick 18, wool 18, grain 17, ore 16; the shuffled face-down development deck has 25 cards; the designated start seat has a legal initial roll.

scenarios.title: Four-player exact board and pieces
scenarios.expectation: The exact page-1 19-hex terrain/number/harbor layout is used; robber is on the central desert; red, blue, orange and white each have the two pictured settlements and roads and remaining stock 13 roads, 3 settlements, 4 cities.

scenarios.title: Four-player lettered starting resources
scenarios.expectation: Red A has wood 2, brick 0, wool 0, grain 1, ore 0; blue B has wood 1, brick 1, wool 0, grain 0, ore 1; orange C has grain 2 and ore 1 only; white D has wood 1, wool 1 and ore 1 only.

scenarios.title: Four-player bank, deck and initial action
scenarios.expectation: Open bank counts are wood 15, brick 18, wool 18, grain 16, ore 16; the shuffled face-down development deck has 25 cards; the designated start seat has a legal initial roll.

scenarios.title: Reject unsupported counts
scenarios.expectation: Approved constructors accept 3 and 4, reject 2 and 5; separate probes check setup, initial action and bounded playability.

scenarios.title: Exact board component inventory
scenarios.expectation: Assert 19 land hexes exactly: wood 4, wool 4, grain 4, brick 3, ore 3, desert 1; six frame pieces; nine harbors; and 18 number tokens with one each 2/12 and two each 3/4/5/6/8/9/10/11.

scenarios.title: Exact resource-card inventory
scenarios.expectation: Across bank and all player hands, assert exactly 19 each of wood, brick, wool, grain and ore (95 total) in both 3p and 4p setup.

scenarios.title: Exact development-card inventory
scenarios.expectation: Across deck and hands, assert 25 total: 14 Knights, exactly two each Road Building/Year of Plenty/Monopoly, and five victory-point cards.

scenarios.title: Exact player-piece and other inventory
scenarios.expectation: Assert each of four colors totals 15 roads, 5 settlements and 4 cities across board/supply; additionally one robber, two dice, four cost cards, two special cards, two card holders and four piece boxes.

scenarios.title: Configured oldest seat starts
scenarios.expectation: At initial state, active_player equals configuration.oldest_player and that seat has the legal initial roll.

scenarios.title: Clockwise next player
scenarios.expectation: Completing a turn advances to the left-neighbor seat.

scenarios.title: Strict roll-trade-build
scenarios.expectation: Roll precedes trade, trade precedes build, and trade cannot resume after entering build.

scenarios.title: Additive production
scenarios.expectation: A scripted non-seven pays every adjacent settlement one and city two, including multiple entitlements.

scenarios.title: No desert or robber production
scenarios.expectation: Desert never pays and an occupied producing hex pays nobody.

scenarios.title: Development timing
scenarios.expectation: An older eligible card may play before roll; a second play and a same-turn purchase are illegal.

scenarios.title: Domestic trade legality
scenarios.expectation: Arbitrary positive resource bundles involving the active player are possible repeatedly; gifts, development cards and non-active-only transfers are rejected.

scenarios.title: Finite bilateral consent
scenarios.expectation: A finite one-partner offer is built by add-one-resource actions, never by enumerating bundle subsets; construction changes no holdings; partner rejection/cancel changes nothing; acceptance transfers full positive bundles atomically.

scenarios.title: Maritime 4:1, 3:1, 2:1
scenarios.expectation: Each rate and port ownership works; wrong specialized resource is rejected.

scenarios.title: New harbor delayed
scenarios.expectation: A harbor settlement built after trade cannot be used in that turn.

scenarios.title: Costs and piece limits
scenarios.expectation: Each purchase removes exact resources and stock; repeated builds/buys are allowed while affordable; no build beyond stock.

scenarios.title: Road occupancy and connectivity
scenarios.expectation: Reject occupied/disconnected edges and continuation through an opponent building; allow valid own connection.

scenarios.title: Settlement road and distance rules
scenarios.expectation: Require own incident road and empty target/adjacent vertices.

scenarios.title: City replacement
scenarios.expectation: Only own settlement upgrades; same vertex becomes city and settlement returns to stock.

scenarios.title: Longest Road threshold and branch
scenarios.expectation: Four does not qualify, five does, and branch edges are not summed.

scenarios.title: Road interruption
scenarios.expectation: Opponent building splits a route; own building does not.

scenarios.title: Longest Road transfer and ties
scenarios.expectation: Strictly longer route transfers; after interruption, incumbent retains a tied lead and a leading tie excluding incumbent leaves the card vacant.

scenarios.title: Edge-simple loop semantics
scenarios.expectation: Loop and figure-eight fixtures compute maximum edge-simple trail without edge reuse and with opponent blockers.

scenarios.title: Seven discard thresholds
scenarios.expectation: Seven pays nothing; sizes 7/8/9/11 discard 0/4/4/5 resources; development cards do not count; trade remains locked until discard, move and robbery finish.

scenarios.title: Robber destination and chosen victim
scenarios.expectation: Must move to a different land hex and choose among adjacent opponents; when the selected victim has resources, exactly one blind resource card transfers and development cards never do.

scenarios.title: Knight differs from seven
scenarios.expectation: Knight immediately moves robber and permits one adjacent robbery without seven-discard checks.

scenarios.title: Seeded blind theft and no victim
scenarios.expectation: Same seed reproduces rolls/deck/theft selection; transfers preserve card counts; an adjacent empty chosen hand or no adjacent opponent transfers nothing.

scenarios.title: Private committed discards
scenarios.expectation: Choices are private until complete and apply together; public pending data reveals quantities/completion but not identities.

scenarios.title: Private top development draw
scenarios.expectation: Purchase takes top deck card privately and decrements deck.

scenarios.title: Two normally legal free roads
scenarios.expectation: Road Building charges no resources and two sequential placements obey normal road rules when two are feasible.

scenarios.title: Year of Plenty
scenarios.expectation: Takes any two available resources including a matching pair.

scenarios.title: Monopoly
scenarios.expectation: Transfers all opponent cards of one resource and none of other resources.

scenarios.title: Played card destinations
scenarios.expectation: Progress leaves play while Knight remains face-up and public.

scenarios.title: Largest Army threshold and transfer
scenarios.expectation: First three gets award; tie retains; strictly larger count transfers.

scenarios.title: Exact scoring
scenarios.expectation: Public and total scoring values match every source-defined point object.

scenarios.title: Immediate active win
scenarios.expectation: Active player reaching ten terminates immediately with no legal actions.

scenarios.title: No off-turn win
scenarios.expectation: Non-active player at ten remains nonterminal, then wins immediately upon becoming active before rolling if still at ten.

scenarios.title: New victory card immediate win
scenarios.expectation: A newly bought VP card may immediately establish active-player victory despite same-turn restriction.

scenarios.title: Minimal victory-card reveal
scenarios.expectation: Only the minimum cards needed for ten reveal, in hand order.

scenarios.title: Source-visible private information
scenarios.expectation: Own identities visible; opponent resource/development identities and hidden victory points remain hidden.

scenarios.title: Public aggregate observation
scenarios.expectation: Observations expose resource hand sizes, face-down development counts, bank, board and visible score without private identities or hidden victory points.

scenarios.title: Full-feasibility shortage decisions
scenarios.expectation: Production is all-or-none per resource across entitlements; bank actions require full stock; development purchase needs deck card; Road Building places maximum feasible up to two.

scenarios.title: Designated oldest start seat
scenarios.expectation: The profile designates player 0 as the oldest seat; player 0 is active and has the initial legal roll in both 3p and 4p games.

scenarios.title: Stable development-card boundaries
scenarios.expectation: An eligible active-player development card may interrupt pending discard, robber, bilateral-consent and card-effect decisions; it resolves on top, then the exact interrupted state resumes unless terminal.

scenarios.title: Immediate victory cancels pending effect
scenarios.expectation: Victory after the first committed Road Building road or other atomic subaction terminates immediately and cancels the remaining effect.
